MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The epoxy, single roll of duct tape, and adhesive fasteners fit the practical repair and mounting needs suggested by my recent nails, screws, and anchors.",
    "The single roll of tape and small set of adhesive strips offer useful quantities for occasional fixes. Super glue also fits small repairs, although I would not choose six bottles right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Eighteen rolls of duct tape and six bottles of glue exceed my current needs; a useful repair material is less appealing when the quantity does not fit the job.",
    "Medicine cups do not mean I need medical gloves or a stethoscope. Likewise, Panasonic-compatible vacuum bags do not imply that I want a replacement vacuum or pet carpet-cleaning formula.",
    "The safety can serves a specific storage need that none of my recent purchases establishes."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My medicine cup purchase seems to have been taken as a broader interest in medical supplies, even though I have not shown a need for clinical equipment.",
    "My vacuum bag purchase seems to have been treated as interest in cleaning products generally, overlooking the specific replacement supply I sought."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters: I sought bags for Panasonic vacuum models, which is a more specific need than interest in any vacuum or cleaning product.",
    "Quantity depends on the task. My large packs of nails and screws do not mean I need bulk quantities of every repair supply.",
    "I choose supplies for particular jobs, so a related product still needs a clear use before I would pick it up."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my repair and maintenance needs, but stretched specific purchases into broader needs and quantities I have not expressed."
}
